prose: Aq is a Rust terminal app that queues every Claude Code session waiting on you: diffs to review, edits to allow, permission prompts and questions, one card at a time. A card arriving while you answer another waits its turn; if you answer in the session's own window, the card stays marked 'answered elsewhere'. Built for people running several tmux sessions; MIT licensed, Linux.
highlights: One queue for all Claude Code sessions needing input
'Answered elsewhere' state when handled in the session
